description: This file defines a PHP class 'DatabaseConfigController' within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the installer module. The class extends an abstract controller and manages the database configuration screen for the installer process, including setting up a Vue component and updating the application state.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigController
classes.description: Controller managing the database configuration step during installation; sets Vue component and updates application state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the database configuration screen by assigning the Vue component and updating the current screen state.
